sections.title: Worry-proof *your roof*

image.alt: An aerial view of a newly shingled roof

body: A maintenance plan for $8.99 a month, a $350 value, that extends the life of your roof and keeps your gutters in top condition. One roof repair can cover the cost of a year’s membership.
Benefits apply while your membership is active. Emergency service isn’t available during active storms, and discounts don’t apply to insurance work.
list: An annual roof inspection with a written report
15% off roof repairs, with a warranty on repairs
Priority emergency service and a discount on temporary tarping

sections.title: Locally owned, *not a franchise*
body: Janson Construction began in 2005, when founders Red Harding and Jay Armstrong combined their experience and their passion for the construction industry. Their vision was a company of excellent quality, service and value.
Red passed away in 2016, and the vision carries on: Jay and the team still live by the Janson IDEAS, the five values behind every job.
